notes: New: ShopCall link. Stock counts come straight from ShopCall (View › Refresh Stock from ShopCall, and automatically at launch), Send to ShopCall… puts the rig in ShopCall's PatchMap inbox for Orders › Import from PatchMap, and File › Link to Gig… lets you save the patch pack PDF and the rig file into the gig's Drive folder. Also: removing a port with cables asks first; printed schematics tile across sheets instead of shrinking; CSV Pack Repo import reads Category as the department; and PatchMap now shares the BSI look (colours, buttons, dialogs, messages) with ShopCall, StandBy and Loader.
